user.title: Connect to HEMS
user.description: Enter your provider's complete HTTPS endpoint. Measurements are sent after setup; device control starts disabled.

measurements.title: Measurement sources
measurements.description:
Positive grid power means import; positive battery power means charging. PV must include direct battery charging. Select non-overlapping PV sources.

Note: HEMS does not check the age of the EV state of charge. Ensure the source integration keeps it current and marks it unavailable when it cannot be used.

error.invalid_endpoint: Use a full HTTPS endpoint without credentials, query parameters or fragment.
error.missing_solar: Select at least one PV production source.

abort.reauth_successful: API key updated. The next exchange will check authentication.

init.title: Measurement sources
init.description:
Saving options reloads the integration. The client does not change hardware settings during reload; local adapter policy owns any fallback.

Note: HEMS does not check the age of the EV state of charge. Ensure the source integration keeps it current and marks it unavailable when it cannot be used.

adapter.title: Optional device adapter
adapter.description: Leave empty for observation only. Scripts must implement ordered writes and independent hardware readback according to the repository's adapter contract. Select only verified supported commands.

error.missing_solar: Select at least one PV production source.
error.incomplete_adapter: Select an apply script and at least one supported command, or clear all adapter fields.

adapter_required.message: Configure an apply script and supported commands before enabling control.
